mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.source: the hello_world_s3_reboot golden's images, committed in web/wasm/fw/public (ESP-IDF v5.5.4 examples/get-started/hello_world)

silicon.board: an ESP32-S3 board, chip revision v0.2, 16 MB flash, connected through its USB-Serial/JTAG port
silicon.flash: esptool 5.3.1: esptool --chip esp32s3 -p PORT write-flash 0x0 hello-bootloader.bin 0x8000 hello-ptable.bin 0x10000 hello_world.bin
silicon.capture: the port opened at 115200, the chip reset by the host through RTS, 32 s read; s3-hello-reboot.txt is the output from the first ROM banner after that reset, line endings normalised to LF

emulator.golden: ESP32SIM_ROM_DIR=roms cargo test --release -p esp32sim --test goldens -- --include-ignored hello_world_s3_reboot
emulator.regenerated: UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 with the same command: tests/golden/hello-s3-reboot.console.txt, tests/golden/hello-s3-reboot.insns
emulator.trace: the golden's command with --max-seconds 11, 11.5, 12 and 21, on main dd4796a0 and on this branch merged onto it; the stop line's core 0 + core 1 instruction counts
emulator.classic: esp32sim --chip esp32 --rom roms/esp32_rev300_rom.elf --board esp32dev --boot rom --no-dump --console uart0 --bootloader web/wasm/fw/public/classic-hello-bootloader.bin --ptable web/wasm/fw/public/classic-hello-ptable.bin --app web/wasm/fw/public/classic-hello_world.bin --max-seconds 30, on main dd4796a0 and on this branch

rom_disassembly: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 image (espressif/idf:v5.5.4), esp-14.2.0_20260121: xtensa-esp32s3-elf-objdump -d esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf and xtensa-esp32-elf-objdump -d esp32_rev300_rom.elf; grep -cE '(wsr|xsr)\.ccount' gives 0 for both (rsr.ccount 11 and 1)
